focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體設備、先進封裝、伺服器電源及資料中心
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductor equipment, advanced packaging, server power and data centers

throughline.zh: 輝達公布資料中心財報及台灣載板、先進封裝新協議，科林研發與半導體廠務業者揭露在台建設及訂單進度，機櫃冷卻與跨境晶片管制亦有新資料。
throughline.en: NVIDIA reported data-center results and new Taiwan substrate and packaging agreements, while equipment and factory-service firms reported Taiwan project milestones and new information emerged on rack cooling and cross-border chip controls.

text.zh: 輝達 FY2027 第三季營收 1,158 億美元、資料中心收入 1,076 億美元，Vera Rubin 已開始出貨；第四季預估 1,300 億美元。
text.en: NVIDIA reported US$115.8bn Q3 revenue and US$107.6bn data-center sales, with Vera Rubin shipments underway and US$130bn Q4 guidance.

text.zh: 景碩桃園幼獅廠供輝達 ABF 載板產能計畫提高至 3.5 倍以上，2028 年第三季為擴充目標。
text.en: Kinsus plans more than 3.5 times its NVIDIA-dedicated Taoyuan ABF substrate capacity by Q3 2028.

text.zh: 矽品與輝達簽多年擴產協議，台灣先進封裝產能規劃於 2029 年中增至 3 倍，精確資金額及驗收尚未公布。
text.en: SPIL and NVIDIA target a threefold Taiwan advanced-packaging expansion by mid-2029, with exact funding and acceptance undisclosed.

text.zh: 科林研發竹南技術中心 11 月 18 日動土，預定 2028 年啟用、實驗室空間增加約 900%。
text.en: Lam Research broke ground in Zhunan on November 18, targeting 2028 opening and about 900% more Taiwan lab space.

text.zh: 漢科公布在手工程訂單 150 億元，八成來自半導體客戶，仍須區分訂單餘額與已完成工程。
text.en: Hanke reports NT$15bn facility-system backlog, 80% from semiconductor customers, distinct from completed work.

title.zh: 輝達 FY2027 第三季營收 1,158 億美元、資料中心收入 1,076 億美元，Vera Rubin 已開始出貨
title.en: NVIDIA reports US$115.8bn FY27 Q3 revenue and US$107.6bn data-center sales as Vera Rubin ships

summary.zh: 輝達 11 月 17 日公布截至 10 月 25 日的 FY2027 第三季營收 1,158 億美元，季增 20%、年增 103%；資料中心部門營收 1,076 億美元，年增 110%。公司指出 Vera Rubin NVL72 與 Vera CPU 已開始大量出貨，第四季預估營收 1,300 億美元，上下容許 3% 誤差；財年與曆年、實績與指引分別標示。
summary.en: On November 17, NVIDIA reported FY2027 Q3 revenue of US$115.8 billion for the quarter ended October 25, up 20% QoQ and 103% YoY. Data-center revenue reached US$107.6 billion, up 110% YoY, while Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs entered volume shipments. Q4 revenue guidance is US$130 billion, plus or minus 3%, and remains a forecast.

label.zh: 產業背景與台灣供應鏈

text.zh: 輝達供應鏈包含台積電晶圓製造及 CoWoS 封裝、台灣載板與封測業者、鴻海伺服器整機及機櫃電源散熱系統。公司稱已出貨 Vera Rubin NVL72，但未公布台灣各供應商的個別出貨台數及電源模組採購額。
text.en: NVIDIA's manufacturing chain includes TSMC wafers and CoWoS, Taiwanese substrate and test suppliers, Foxconn server systems, and rack power and cooling hardware. NVIDIA confirmed Vera Rubin NVL72 shipments but did not disclose Taiwan supplier-specific rack counts or component purchase amounts.

text.zh: 第三季 GAAP 毛利率 74.8%、營業利益 775 億美元、淨利 653 億美元；上季及去年同季總營收分別為 962 億、570 億美元。非 GAAP 毛利率 74.9% 及調整後每股盈餘 2.68 美元是不同會計口徑，不與 GAAP 利益混為一談。
text.en: Q3 GAAP gross margin was 74.8%, operating income US$77.5 billion and net income US$65.3 billion. Prior-quarter revenue was US$96.2 billion and prior-year revenue US$57.0 billion. Non-GAAP gross margin of 74.9% and adjusted EPS of US$2.68 are separate accounting measures.

text.zh: 公司稱 Vera Rubin 相關機櫃已在部分雲端合作夥伴運作，第四季 FY2027（比一般季度多一週）營收展望為 1,300 億美元，上下 3%，並未計入來自中國的資料中心運算營收。公司收入並不等於新 GPU 機櫃全部驗收數量。
text.en: The company reported Vera Rubin racks operating at some cloud partners. FY2027 Q4 contains an extra week, with revenue guidance of US$130 billion ±3% excluding China data-center compute revenue. Company revenue does not disclose accepted rack units across all system suppliers.

text.zh: 台灣供應商逐廠 GPU 機櫃、電源轉換、冷卻系統及採購合約數量尚未單獨公布。
text.en: Taiwan vendor-specific GPU racks, power conversion, cooling units and binding contract quantities remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 景碩獲輝達新協議，桃園幼獅 ABF 載板專屬產能規劃擴至 3.5 倍以上
title.en: Kinsus to expand NVIDIA-dedicated Taoyuan ABF substrate capacity beyond 3.5 times under new agreement

summary.zh: 輝達 11 月 17 日宣布與景碩簽訂多年載板供應協議，規劃將桃園幼獅廠支援輝達的先進 ABF 載板產能提高至現有 3.5 倍以上，2027 年下半年開始生產、2028 年第三季達成新增產能目標。景碩 11 月 18 日表示獲輝達超過 10 億美元資金支援設備擴充，資金用途與量產狀態仍依後續公告確認。
summary.en: NVIDIA announced a multiyear Kinsus agreement on November 17 targeting more than 3.5 times the current NVIDIA-dedicated advanced ABF substrate capacity at the Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan. Production is scheduled to begin in H2 2027 with the incremental capacity targeted for Q3 2028. Kinsus told CNA on November 18 that NVIDIA would provide over US$1 billion for equipment expansion; production and financing terms still require subsequent disclosures.

text.zh: ABF 封裝載板位於晶圓封裝至伺服器系統之間，涉及高密度導線層、材料、壓合與精密測試。3.5 倍是景碩供應輝達的特定產能規劃，不能套用到全公司或所有台灣載板廠。
text.en: ABF substrates link semiconductor packages to server systems and require multilayer fabrication, advanced materials, lamination and test. The more-than-3.5-times target concerns NVIDIA-dedicated capacity at the specified campus, not all Kinsus or Taiwan substrate output.

text.zh: 輝達原廠公告新多年協議及幼獅廠時程；景碩對中央社表示獲現金資金超過 10 億美元，目的為新增設備。公告未拆分預付款、股權投資或各類設備採購條款，故這筆資金不直接列作既成財務支出。
text.en: NVIDIA's release confirms the new agreement and Youth campus timing. Kinsus told CNA it would receive over US$1 billion to fund new equipment, but the public material does not fully reconcile the financing mechanics, equity treatment or procurement schedules.

text.zh: 2027 年下半年起生產與 2028 年第三季達成目標均為未來規劃。無明確新載板實際月片數、良率、客戶驗收量或最終已簽認列收入。
text.en: H2 2027 production and Q3 2028 additional capacity are targets. New monthly substrate counts, yields, accepted output and recognized contracted revenue were not supplied.

text.zh: 新增設備台數、正式產能基數、客戶驗收、付款形式及與其他廠區的範圍尚未公布。
text.en: Tool counts, precise capacity baseline, customer acceptance, payment structure and expansion beyond Youth remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 矽品與輝達簽多年協議，台灣先進封裝產能規劃 2029 年中擴至 3 倍
title.en: SPIL targets threefold Taiwan advanced-packaging capacity by mid-2029 under NVIDIA agreement

summary.zh: 矽品 11 月 18 日發布與輝達多年期先進封裝產能擴充協議，規劃於 2029 年年中前將台灣相關先進封裝產能擴至原來 3 倍，協議有數十億美元資金支持但未公布精確總額。規劃涵蓋凸塊、組裝、測試與廠務自動化，尚未公布新增月封裝件數及完成量產驗收的時間。
summary.en: SPIL announced on November 18 a multiyear NVIDIA-backed agreement targeting three times its relevant advanced-packaging capacity in Taiwan by mid-2029. The agreement involves multibillion-dollar funding without an exact public amount and covers bumping, assembly, testing and facility automation. Monthly package units and customer-qualified production dates were not published.

label.zh: 先進封裝供應鏈與工程範圍
label.en: Packaging supply chain and project scope

text.zh: 矽品將新設高精度、高產量封裝產線，整合凸塊、晶片組裝、測試及工程管理。輝達公告另提到中介層晶圓製程的整合支援；不同公司公告的工序細節互有範圍差異，不能單獨推定某段製程全由矽品承作。
text.en: SPIL plans high-throughput packaging lines covering bumping, assembly, test and related facilities. NVIDIA also describes interposer-related turnkey support. The releases differ slightly in process wording and do not assign every interposer step exclusively to SPIL.

text.zh: 矽品原廠及輝達均指出有數十億美元資金支持，沒有精確可逐項對照的付款表。至 2029 年年中增加到三倍，屬受託先進封裝產能目標，尚非現在的製造實績。
text.en: Both parties describe multibillion-dollar funding without an itemized payment schedule. Threefold capacity by mid-2029 is a future NVIDIA-related advanced-packaging target, not current wafer or package output.

text.zh: 原有每月產能基數、建廠與設備分期支出、客戶驗收以及逐平台良率未公開。
text.en: The monthly baseline, staged capex, customer acceptances and yields by platform are undisclosed.

title.zh: 科林研發竹南技術中心動土，預定 2028 年啟用、在台實驗室空間增約 900%
title.en: Lam Research breaks ground in Zhunan, targeting 2028 opening and about 900% more Taiwan lab space

summary.zh: 美商科林研發 11 月 18 日於苗栗竹南舉行新台灣技術中心動土典禮，預計 2028 年啟用，場址規劃超過 4 萬平方公尺，完工後在台實驗室空間預計增加約 900%。新中心屬公司未來五年逾 30 億美元的全球研發投資計畫之一，該金額涵蓋全球各地，不代表竹南單一據點的投資額。
summary.en: Lam Research held a groundbreaking on November 18 for its new Zhunan technology center in Miaoli County, Taiwan, targeting a 2028 opening. The planned site exceeds 40,000 square meters and would expand Taiwan laboratory space by about 900%. The project is one part of Lam's more-than-US$3 billion five-year global R&D network program, not a US$3 billion budget for this Taiwan site alone.

label.zh: 晶圓設備與實驗室用途

text.zh: 苗栗縣政府說明新中心將支援薄膜沉積、蝕刻、先進封裝等製程的研發、測試及驗證，並靠近客戶及台灣製造據點。這類技術中心是開發與驗證設施，不能直接當作晶圓量產產線。
text.en: The Miaoli government describes facilities for deposition, etch, advanced-packaging R&D and qualification near customers and existing manufacturing sites. These are development and validation laboratories, not new wafer manufacturing lines.

text.zh: 動土時間為 11 月 18 日，官方預定 2028 年啟用並預期新增數百名工作機會。逾 30 億美元是五年全球研發網路總計畫，該址施工預算和實際付款未列明。
text.en: The groundbreaking occurred November 18, with the opening targeted for 2028 and several hundred jobs anticipated. The more-than-US$3 billion figure covers a five-year global network; the site-specific budget and spending remain unpublished.

text.zh: 各研究設備數量、廠務總電力負載、台灣個別投資額及啟用後客戶認證時程未公布。
text.en: R&D tool counts, site power load, Taiwan-specific capex and customer qualification timing are unknown.

title.zh: 漢科公布在手訂單 150 億元，八成來自半導體客戶
title.en: Hanke reports NT$15bn order backlog with 80% from semiconductor customers

summary.zh: 漢科系統科技 11 月 18 日參加櫃買市場業績發表會，表示目前在手訂單 150 億元，其中約 80% 來自半導體客戶，工作範圍涉及高科技廠房廠務與算力設施。公司提及台灣、新加坡、美國、日本及德國據點，但未公布在手訂單的逐年認列、個別客戶或已驗收工程金額。
summary.en: Hanke Systems reported at a November 18 TPEx business briefing that its backlog was NT$15 billion, around 80% from semiconductor customers. The company provides facilities systems for high-tech manufacturing and compute infrastructure across Taiwan and overseas locations including Singapore. Timing of backlog recognition, customer-level contracts and completed acceptance were not disclosed.

text.zh: 半導體與先進封裝擴產涉及廠務氣體、液體、配電、控制和安裝工程。漢科的在手訂單是未完成履約的工作範圍，不能直接等同已完成工程營收。
text.en: Semiconductor and packaging capacity projects involve factory gases, fluids, electrical distribution, controls and installation. Backlog is a contracted work measure, not completed construction revenue.

text.zh: 管理階層指出在手訂單 150 億元、約八成為半導體客戶，並預期部分 HBM、DRAM、載板及先進封裝擴建會延續至 2028 至 2029 年。後者為企業展望，未提供各工地完工和交付里程碑。
text.en: Management reported NT$15 billion in orders on hand and approximately an 80% semiconductor mix, with certain HBM, DRAM, substrate and packaging projects expected through 2028–2029. Those expectations lack site-level completion and handover dates.

text.zh: 正式認列期間、工程項目個別毛利、機櫃相關廠務支出及新加坡專案金額未披露。
text.en: Revenue recognition periods, margins by project, rack-specific facility expenses and Singapore project amounts remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 其曜 SC26 展示雙相直接液冷機架方案，宣稱單櫃最高 200kW 解熱能力
title.en: Qisda affiliate Chiyau showcases two-phase rack cooling rated up to 200kW at SC26

summary.zh: 佳世達集團旗下其陽科技 11 月 18 日宣布子公司其曜科技於美國芝加哥 SC26 展示雙相直接液冷機架方案，產品宣稱單機架最高 200kW 解熱能力。方案涵蓋智慧型冷卻液分配單元、相變微通道蓋板及無滴漏快接頭；公司未公布獨立實測條件、商業出貨台數或客戶驗收紀錄。
summary.en: On November 18, Qisda group company Chiyau announced a two-phase direct-liquid-cooling rack solution at SC26 in Chicago, claiming up to 200kW of heat removal per rack. Components include a CDU, phase-change microchannel cold plate and dripless connectors. Independent test conditions, commercial shipments and customer acceptance counts were not disclosed.

text.zh: 兩相直接液冷利用介電液相變傳熱，與單相水冷液迴路不同。其曜的技術模組包含動態冷卻控制、熱交換、流體分配與維護安全，不應直接將設計散熱能力視為已完成機房實際負載。
text.en: Two-phase direct liquid cooling uses dielectric-fluid phase change, distinct from single-phase water loops. Chiyau describes dynamic control, heat exchange, distribution and service interfaces; a claimed cooling rating is not a measured operating data-center load.

text.zh: 公司展示最高 200kW 整櫃解熱規格，未列出冷卻液流量、溫差、晶片發熱分布、測試標準及供電架構的完整數值。該宣稱為供應商產品規格。
text.en: The claimed maximum 200kW cooling rating is a product specification. Coolant flow, temperature differential, chip heat distribution, benchmark standard and full rack electrical requirements were not provided.

text.zh: 實測散熱效率、可連續負載、客戶認證及量產出貨台數仍待核對。
text.en: Measured cooling efficiency, sustained heat load, customer qualification and production deliveries remain unknown.

title.zh: 追蹤：新加坡副總理回應美國晶片管制，稱正與企業評估影響
title.en: Follow-up: Singapore deputy prime minister says firms are assessing U.S. advanced-chip controls

summary.zh: 新加坡副總理顏金勇 11 月 18 日在新加坡金融科技節表示，政府正與企業討論美國新高階晶片出口規範的影響，並強調不允許企業利用新加坡業務規避他國法律。美國 11 月 16 日公布的規範已在 11/18 日報說明，本次新增的是新加坡政府的公開回應；未提供受影響的資料中心數量或許可申請結果。
summary.en: At Singapore FinTech Festival on November 18, Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said authorities were working with businesses to assess new U.S. advanced-chip restrictions and would not tolerate evasion of other countries' laws through Singapore operations. The U.S. rule had already been covered in the November 18 edition; the new development is Singapore's public response, without data-center counts or licensing outcomes.

text.zh: 美國規範針對特定高階晶片輸往新加坡等目的地及向受管制客戶提供遠端算力，適用情況需依晶片型號、最終母公司及用途判定。新加坡的政策聲明尚無具體修訂本地法律的文字。
text.en: The U.S. controls address specified chips shipped to named destinations and some remote compute services, with applicability depending on hardware, corporate ownership and end use. Singapore's statement did not itself enact a new domestic statute.

label.zh: 11 月 18 日官方說法與限制

text.zh: 顏金勇表示重視新加坡企業的國際信譽，政府與企業正在共同評估規範影響，違反適用法律者可能面臨行動。報導沒有公開特定晶片批次、受影響業者名單或已核准出口許可。
text.en: Gan emphasized Singapore's international reputation and ongoing consultations with firms. CNA's report does not identify chip shipments, affected operators or license grants, so implementation effects cannot yet be quantified.

text.zh: 新加坡企業申請或取得出口許可數量、新增本地監管措施及現有機房可用晶片存量未公布。
text.en: The number of applications or approvals, new local measures and installed chip inventories at Singapore data centers remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 台灣光罩披露已有 1 家矽光子客戶量產，規劃 2027 年建廠資本支出 5 至 10 億元
title.en: Taiwan Mask says one photonic-IC customer is in production, with NT$0.5–1bn capex planned for 2027

summary.zh: 台灣光罩於 11 月 17 日法說表示矽光子 PIC 業務已有 1 家客戶量產，另有其他客戶合作，並規劃 2027 年投資 5 至 10 億元擴充光罩產能。11 月 18 日公司另對媒體的營收及產能報導發布重大訊息，澄清 2027 年約 20% 營收成長等數字屬管理層對未來的努力目標，未形成已實現營收。
summary.en: Taiwan Mask said at its November 17 briefing that one photonic-IC customer has entered production and that it plans NT$0.5–1 billion in 2027 capital expenditure. On November 18, a reproduced material filing clarified that reported revenue and capacity ambitions, including roughly 20% revenue growth for 2027, are management goals rather than booked results.

text.zh: 光子積體電路 PIC 與電子積體電路 EIC 的開發需要光罩製作和晶圓製程驗證。公司稱已有 1 家客戶量產，但未公布每月 PIC 光罩張數及該客戶產品營收。
text.en: Photonic and electronic IC development uses masks and wafer-level qualification. Taiwan Mask reports one PIC customer in production without mask-volume or customer-revenue disclosure.

text.zh: 公司說明 2027 年資本支出預估 5 至 10 億元，新廠規劃仍須完成相關核准。11 月 18 日公司重訊明確指出媒體對 2027 年營收及產能展望是管理層個人對長期產業潛力的期待，實際績效以公開財務公告為準。
text.en: The firm outlined NT$0.5–1 billion planned capex for 2027. Its November 18 material statement says media-reported 2027 revenue and capacity targets reflect management aspirations, with financial outcomes subject to official results.

text.zh: 新廠實際動工日、光罩月產能、PIC 客戶量產出貨量及日本 TCK 收購完成日期未公布。
text.en: New-factory construction, monthly photomask output, PIC customer shipments and the completion of its Japan TCK acquisition remain unverified.

title.zh: 均華精密核准竹北兩筆土地取得案，總額約 14.99 億元
title.en: All Ring Tech approves two Zhubei property acquisitions totaling about NT$1.499bn

summary.zh: 半導體封測設備廠均華 11 月 18 日董事會核准取得新竹縣竹北市泰和段兩筆土地及部分建物，交易金額分別為 8.2688 億及 6.7221 億元，合計約 14.99 億元。公告用途為長期營運及空間規劃，尚未核定或披露新增封測設備產能、投產時點及建廠工程預算。
summary.en: All Ring Tech's board approved two property purchases in Zhubei, Hsinchu County, on November 18: NT$826.88 million and NT$672.21 million, totaling about NT$1.49909 billion. The company describes long-term operating and space planning, without disclosing a new equipment factory's output, commissioning date or construction budget.

text.zh: 均華業務涉及半導體封裝黏晶設備及組裝測試自動化。兩筆交易屬土地及部分建物取得，不可直接將買地金額當成新產線機台投資。
text.en: All Ring Tech supplies semiconductor die-bonding and back-end automation equipment. The transactions are real estate acquisitions and do not establish equipment-tool spending.

text.zh: 第一筆泰和段土地 6,667.13 平方公尺，總價 826,880,000 元；第二筆土地 4,582.18 平方公尺，總價 672,210,000 元。兩案合計 1,499,090,000 元，這是兩個不同標的的數學加總。
text.en: The first parcel is 6,667.13 square meters at NT$826.88 million; the second includes 4,582.18 square meters of land and buildings at NT$672.21 million. Together they total NT$1,499.09 million across distinct properties.

text.zh: 土地移轉完成、廠房規格、正式擴產計畫、設備裝機及客戶驗收日期均未公布。
text.en: Land closing, facility specifications, approved expansion plans, tool installation and customer acceptance dates remain unknown.

location.en: Asset sites: two properties in Taihe Section, Zhubei, Hsinchu County, Taiwan; cadastral parcels are specified without conventional street addresses.

industries.en: Equipment; packaging; testing; factories; automation; investment

chain.en: Semiconductor packaging tool supplier acquires land for potential future factory use

investment.zh: 兩筆核准交易總額約 14.99 億元，未公布新機台採購支出。
investment.en: Two approved transactions total approximately NT$1.499 billion; no new tool-purchase amount.

demand.en: No incremental packaging tool delivery capacity was disclosed.

relevance.en: Property acquisition supports operating-space planning, not completed capacity.

timing.zh: 兩筆交易均於 11 月 18 日核准。

unknowns.zh: 新廠工程與實際設備交付仍未確認。

ceoView.zh: 對半導體後段製程設備、精密量測及產線控制供應商而言，均華已核准增加用地資產，建廠與機台交付仍是未知事項。需要核對廠房施工時程、設備線別及產能驗收，不能從購地價推算設備收入。
ceoView.en: For semiconductor back-end equipment, metrology and production controls suppliers, All Ring Tech approved additional property but tool installation remains unknown. Construction timelines, tool lines and acceptance are necessary; land price is not equipment revenue.

question.zh: 輝達第四季 1,300 億美元與第三季 1,158 億美元能直接當成同期間實績比較嗎？
question.en: Are NVIDIA's Q4 US$130bn guidance and Q3 US$115.8bn directly comparable actuals?

text.zh: 第三季是截至 10 月 25 日的已公布財報，第四季為尚未實現的預測，且 FY2027 第四季比一般季度多一週。
text.en: Q3 is reported revenue for the quarter ended October 25. Q4 is forecast and contains an additional week.

question.zh: 景碩產能 3.5 倍是否代表整家公司現在已增產 3.5 倍？
question.en: Does the Kinsus 3.5-times figure mean its entire business has already expanded?

text.zh: 該數值指桃園幼獅廠專供輝達的特定 ABF 載板產能目標，預定 2028 年第三季到位，當前實際增加的月片數未公布。
text.en: The target refers to NVIDIA-dedicated ABF capacity at Taoyuan Youth campus, slated for Q3 2028. Actual incremental monthly output is undisclosed.

question.zh: 矽品協議與輝達財報中的先進封裝出貨是同一指標嗎？
question.en: Is SPIL's future packaging expansion the same measure as NVIDIA's existing shipments?

text.zh: 矽品規劃 2029 年中產能增至三倍，是未來封裝能力；輝達已出貨 Vera Rubin 為已發生的平台里程碑，兩者不能互相代換。
text.en: SPIL's mid-2029 capacity plan is prospective packaging capability, while NVIDIA's shipped Vera Rubin platforms are current operational milestones. They should not be interchanged.

title.zh: 同一供應鏈協議的既有部分

text.zh: 輝達 10 月 21 日已公布京元電測試、欣興與 IBIDEN 載板，以及矽品光引擎擴充規劃。11 月 17 日新公告新增景碩特定載板協議和矽品先進封裝擴充細節，舊規劃保留明確公告日期。
text.en: NVIDIA's October 21 release already covered KYEC testing, Unimicron and IBIDEN substrates, and SPIL optical-engine plans. The new November 17 announcement adds specific Kinsus substrate and SPIL packaging commitments; earlier plans retain their original announcement dates.

title.zh: 展會重複介紹與股價評論
title.en: Repeated exhibition descriptions and stock commentary

text.zh: 11 月 17 日日報已收錄神雲、康舒等 SC26 相關展示；單純重複原規格與股價反應的報導不列為新事件。
text.en: The November 18 edition already covered MiTAC, AcBel and other SC26 exhibits. Reposts of prior specifications and stock-price reactions were not treated as new events.

verificationNote.zh: 輝達 FY2027 第四季指引含額外一週，且與第三季已實現營收分開。景碩 3.5 倍及矽品 3 倍均為未來特定產能目標；科林逾 30 億美元為全球五年研發計畫而非竹南單點投資。漢科訂單未揭露履約時程；均華交易細節主要依重訊轉載與媒體核對，尚未獨立取得交易所原始頁面。
verificationNote.en: NVIDIA's FY2027 Q4 guidance includes an extra week and is separate from Q3 actuals. Kinsus' 3.5-times and SPIL's threefold figures are future, scope-specific capacity targets. Lam's more-than-US$3bn program is global, not Zhunan site-specific. Hanke backlog lacks a fulfillment schedule, and All Ring Tech property details were checked via reproduced filings rather than an original exchange filing page.
